numbering_hint_sheet_zone: Sheet by sheet, zone by zone, then top to bottom and left to right. Without a zone grid the whole sheet is read that way.
numbering_hint_view: View by view in the order the views were drawn, top to bottom and left to right inside a view. Balloons outside all views come last.
numbering_hint_view_clockwise: View by view, clockwise around the view center from 12 o'clock. Balloons outside all views come last.
numbering_hint_kind: Grouped by kind, each kind in sheet and zone order.
numbering_hint_manual: Keeps the current order. Drag rows in the table to change it.
numbering_locked: Numbering is locked. Existing numbers stay, new characteristics are numbered by the insert policy.
zones_none: No zone grid. Numbering then reads the whole sheet.
zones_columns_letters: A, B, C from the left
zones_columns_letters_reversed: A, B, C from the right
zones_rows_letters: A, B, C from the top
zones_rows_letters_reversed: A, B, C from the bottom
zones_labels_hint: Separate labels with commas. The count of labels sets the number of columns and rows.
regions_drawing_hint: Drag a rectangle on the drawing. Esc cancels.
views_none: No views drawn. Views are used by the per view strategies.
dev_pan_result: {frames} frames, mean {mean} ms, p95 {p95} ms, max {max} ms
unsaved_body: The project has changes that are not saved yet.
notice_restored_unsaved: A project that was not saved yet was restored after the last session ended unexpectedly. Save it to keep it.
notice_recovered: {count} changes were restored from the autosave journal.
notice_dropped: The last change before the unexpected end was incomplete and was dropped.
notice_set_aside: An autosave journal did not match the project and was not applied. It was kept as {path}.
notice_migrated: The project was converted from file format version {version}. Saving writes the current format.
error_in_use: The project is open in another DimoMark window.
error_in_use_by: The project is open in another DimoMark window (user {user}).
error_newer_version: The project was written by a newer DimoMark version (file format {found}, this version reads up to {supported}). Update DimoMark to open it.
error_io_not_found: The file or folder was not found.
error_io_permission_denied: DimoMark has no permission to access the file or folder.
error_io_target_locked: The file is open in another program. Close it there and try again.
error_io_disk_full: The disk is full. Free some space and try again.
error_io_other: A file could not be read or written.
error_document_not_a_pdf: The file is not a PDF drawing.
error_document_image_not_supported: Drawings from images (photos, scans) are not supported yet. Use a PDF.
error_document_damaged: The PDF cannot be read. It may be damaged or protected by a password.
error_document_too_large: The drawing file is too large.
error_document_no_pdf_engine: The PDF component is missing, drawings cannot be opened.
error_argument_shorter_leg: The shorter leg must be a positive number.
error_argument_region: The box must be larger than zero.
error_argument_unreadable: The value could not be read.
error_argument_request: DimoMark could not carry out the request.
error_project_not_a_project: The file is not a DimoMark project.
error_project_damaged_container: The project file is damaged and cannot be read.
error_project_too_large: The project file is too large to open.
error_project_migration_failed: The project could not be converted from its older file format.
error_project_missing_drawing: The drawing is missing from the project file.
error_project_missing_table: A company table that the project uses is missing from the project file.
error_project_changed_table: A company table in the project file was changed outside DimoMark.
error_project_no_file: The project has not been saved yet. Use Save as…
error_export_target_locked: The file is open in another program. Close it there and export again.
error_export_permission_denied: DimoMark may not write to this folder or file. Choose another folder.
error_export_disk_full: The disk is full. Free some space and export again.
error_export_write_failed: The file could not be written.
error_export_invalid_file_name: This is not a valid file name.
error_export_no_pdf_engine: The PDF component is missing, the PDF with balloons cannot be made.
error_export_pdf_failed: The PDF with balloons could not be made.
error_export_report_failed: The report could not be made.
error_export_list_failed: The characteristic list could not be written.
error_export_wrong_extension: The file was not opened because its file type does not match the export.
error_export_open_failed: No program could open the file.
error_recent_not_listed: This project is not in the list of recently opened projects.
error_recent_missing: The project file was not found. It was moved, renamed or is on a drive that is not connected.
error_internal_shipped_tables: The tolerance tables that come with DimoMark cannot be loaded. Install DimoMark again.
error_internal_report_template: The report template that comes with DimoMark cannot be loaded. Install DimoMark again.
error_internal_window: The window could not carry out the action.
error_internal_bug: Something went wrong inside DimoMark. Please report it together with the details.
error_task_failed: A background task stopped unexpectedly. Try again.
autosave_failed_no_folder: Not saved, no folder for autosave
autosave_failed_disk_full: Autosave failed: the disk is full
autosave_failed_permission_denied: Autosave failed: no permission for the folder
table_import_too_large: The file is too large for a table.
table_import_not_text: The file is not a text file (UTF-8).
table_import_syntax: The file does not follow the table format.
table_import_invalid_content: A value or a row breaks the rules for tables.
table_import_not_company_table: The file is not a company table (kind = "custom").
table_import_duplicate_id: A table that comes with DimoMark already has this id.
table_import_settings_conflict: The table does not fit the tolerance settings of the project, for example a class they use is missing.
table_locked_manual: Numbering was locked by {user} on {date}. Characteristics cannot be moved while numbering is locked.
table_locked_issued: Numbering was locked when a report was issued ({user}, {date}). Characteristics cannot be moved while numbering is locked.
refusal_numbering_locked: Numbering is locked. Characteristics cannot be moved.
refusal_zero_quantity: The quantity must be at least 1.
refusal_invalid_quantity: The quantity must be a whole number of at least 1.
refusal_invalid_decimal: Not a valid number. Use digits with a point, for example 12.5 or -0.02.
refusal_invalid_move_target: Characteristics cannot be moved before one of themselves.
table_toggle: Table: select row or switch Inspect
dev_table_result: Table: {frames} frames, mean {mean} ms, p95 {p95} ms, max {max} ms
select_all: Select all balloons on the sheet
note_shorter_leg_unknown: Angle: the length of the shorter leg is unknown, so the general tolerance for angles is not applied. Enter the shorter leg below.
shorter_leg_hint: Length of the shorter leg of the angle in the sheet unit. It selects the general tolerance for angles (ISO 2768-1). Leave empty if unknown.
shorter_leg_invalid: Enter a positive number, for example 40 or 12.5.
shorter_leg_stored: Stored leg: {value} {unit}. A new value is in the sheet unit.
shorter_leg_manual_kept: Leg stored. The limits were entered by hand and stay.
shorter_leg_unreadable: Leg stored. The requirement text is not a dimension, so it gives no limits.
note_fit_pair: Fit pair: it names a hole and a shaft. Capture them as two characteristics.
proposal_parse_error: Not read as a callout (character {position}: {expected}). Accepting keeps the text only.
proposal_not_inspected: Reference or basic dimension, not inspected
view_planned: This view comes in a later version.
export_language_hint: Language of the column headers in CSV and Excel files and of the reports.
export_open_failed: The file was saved but could not be opened: {message}
export_issued_hint: For drawings and reports that go to a customer. Numbers then stay fixed; new characteristics get the next free number. A report exported as issued is recorded in the project.
export_locked: The numbering is locked. Reports exported as issued are still recorded.
export_pdf_description: A copy of the drawing with the balloons. The original file is not changed.
export_csv_description: For CMM programming and other tools. UTF-8, comma separated.
export_xlsx_description: The same list as an Excel workbook.
export_waiting: Choose where to save the file.
export_blank_columns_hint: Columns of a check sheet when the project has no parts (1 to 10).
export_cancelled: Export cancelled. No file was written.
export_issued_recorded: Recorded as issued; the numbering is locked.
export_issued_project_changed: The project changed during the export, so the report was not recorded as issued. Export it again.
export_issued_refused: The report was not recorded as issued: {message}
export_warning_draft: Some limits come from tolerance tables that are still drafts.
export_warning_open: Results are missing or not evaluated; the overall verdict is open.
export_warning_changed: Limits or result types changed after the last issued report.
language_hint: Changing the language reloads the window.
user_name_hint: Recorded with every change. Leave empty to use the system user name ({name}).
settings_balloon_defaults_hint: Applies to every balloon of the project that has no style of its own.
settings_no_project: Open a project to change its balloon style.
badge_draft_title: Limits from a draft table: its values are not verified yet
badge_no_tolerance_title: No tolerance on the drawing and no rule that gives one: no limits. Check this characteristic.
badge_reference_title: Reference dimension: no limits, not inspected unless you tick Inspect
badge_basic_title: Basic (theoretically exact) dimension: no limits, not inspected unless you tick Inspect
hint_fit_deviations_differ: The printed deviations differ from the fit table for {fit}; the printed ones are used.
hint_unknown_fit: Fit {fit} is not in the fit table.
hint_size_outside_table: The size is outside the ranges of table {table}.
detail_no_rule: No rule recorded yet. Type the requirement text or choose Update limits.
detail_reinterpret_hint: Reads the requirement text again with the current tolerance settings, as one undo step. Limits entered by hand stay.
detail_reinterpret_done: Limits updated: {count}. Kept because entered by hand: {manual}. Not readable: {unreadable}.
tolerance_general_offer_one: 1 characteristic has no tolerance yet or the previous general tolerance. Give it the general tolerance now?
tolerance_general_offer_other: {count} characteristics have no tolerance yet or the previous general tolerance. Give them the general tolerance now?
tolerance_general_remove_one: 1 characteristic still has the previous general tolerance. Remove it now?
tolerance_general_remove_other: {count} characteristics still have the previous general tolerance. Remove it now?
tolerance_decimal_rules_hint: For sizes written as decimals without a tolerance, for example 2 places ±0.05.
tolerance_no_custom: No company tables in this project.
tolerance_imported: Imported {table}. It is saved with the project.
tolerance_import_unchanged: {table} is already in the project. Nothing changed.
tolerance_places_invalid: Decimal places must be a whole number from 0 to 10.
copy_hash_aria: Copy the SHA-256 of the drawing
report_date_today_aria: Set the report date to today
company_name_hint: Printed on reports. Copied into the report details of a project that has no company name yet.
refusal_unknown_revision: This drawing revision no longer exists.
refusal_not_an_image: Only drawings from a photo or scan have image settings.
refusal_invalid_image_edit: The image settings are out of range.
refusal_empty_serial: The serial number must not be empty.
refusal_duplicate_serial: Another part already has this serial number.
refusal_too_many_samples: A project holds at most 500 parts.
refusal_invalid_sample_count: Add between 1 and 100 parts at once.
refusal_invalid_date: Not a valid date. Use the form 2026-10-12.
refusal_invalid_result: Not a valid result for this characteristic. Enter a number, or OK or not OK when the result type is OK / not OK.
refusal_result_type_conflict: The results of this characteristic do not fit the chosen result type. Clear them first.
refusal_invalid_geometry: The position or area is not valid.
refusal_invalid_style: Balloon sizes must be positive numbers.
refusal_invalid_sheet_setting: This sheet setting is not valid (unit, scale, zone grid or view).
refusal_invalid_project_setting: These project settings are not valid.
refusal_missing_table: This company table is not stored in the project yet. Import it again.
grid_next_row: Grid: confirm and go to the next characteristic
grid_previous_row: Grid: confirm and go to the previous characteristic
grid_next_sample: Grid: confirm and go to the next part
grid_previous_sample: Grid: confirm and go to the previous part
grid_ok: Grid: OK (result type OK / not OK)
grid_not_ok: Grid: not OK (result type OK / not OK)
grid_toggle: Grid: switch between OK and not OK
grid_paste: Grid: paste a block of values
measure_refused_number: Not a number. Type digits with a point or comma, for example 12.05 or -0,3.
measure_refused_attribute: Not an OK or not OK result. Type o or + for OK, n or x for not OK.
measure_type_refused: Result type of characteristic {number} not changed: {message}
measure_paste_no_cell: Choose the cell where the pasted block starts.
measure_paste_too_big: The pasted block ({rows} rows by {columns} columns) does not fit from this cell. Add parts or start further up or left.
measure_paste_invalid: a value in the block does not fit the result type of its characteristic.
measure_changed_since_issue: Limits or result type changed after the last issued report
delete_results_body_one: 1 result will be removed with the deleted characteristics. Undo brings it back.
delete_results_body_other: {count} results will be removed with the deleted characteristics. Undo brings them back.
sample_panel_empty: Choose the column of a part in the grid.
cmd_save_desc: Saves the project in its file.
cmd_save_as_desc: Saves the project in a new file.
cmd_new_desc: Starts a project from a PDF drawing.
cmd_redo_desc: Does the last undone change again.
cmd_theme_desc: Switches between the light and the dark look.
cmd_select_desc: Pick balloons to move, edit or delete them.
cmd_place_desc: Click a dimension to number it, or drag a box around it to read the text. Esc stops.
cmd_edit_value_desc: Opens the value of the selected balloon for typing.
cmd_balloon_style_desc: Shape, size and color of the selected balloons.
cmd_delete_desc: Deletes the selected characteristics with their balloons.
cmd_renumber_desc: Numbers all balloons again in the chosen order. One undo step.
cmd_preview_numbers_desc: Shows the new numbers on the drawing before you renumber.
field_general_tolerance_desc: Tolerance for dimensions without their own tolerance, from the title block.
cmd_update_limits_desc: Reads the selected characteristics again with the current tolerance settings. Limits you typed by hand stay.
cmd_rotate_left_desc: Turns the sheet a quarter turn to the left.
cmd_rotate_right_desc: Turns the sheet a quarter turn to the right.
field_unit_desc: Unit of the dimensions on this sheet. DimoMark never guesses it from the sheet size.
field_scale_desc: Scale printed in the title block. Custom… opens a small dialog for other scales.
cmd_zone_grid_desc: Drag a frame around the zone grid of the sheet. Columns, rows and labels are set in the properties pane.
cmd_draw_view_desc: Drag a box around one view of the part, for numbering by view. The properties pane lists the views.
cmd_decimal_rules_desc: Tolerances by number of decimal places, and rounding after a unit conversion.
cmd_company_tables_desc: Your own tolerance tables and the drawing rule of this project.
cmd_project_info_desc: Part, drawing and report details in File > Info.
cmd_add_parts_desc: Adds as many parts as given in Number, one column each.
cmd_move_part_left_desc: Moves the active part one column to the left.
cmd_move_part_right_desc: Moves the active part one column to the right.
cmd_delete_part_desc: Deletes the active part. Asks first when it has results.
cmd_paste_values_desc: Pastes values from the clipboard, starting at the active cell.
cmd_paste_hint: Press {keys} to paste the values here.
cmd_clear_cell_desc: Removes the value of the active cell.
field_row_result_desc: Measured value or OK / not OK for the active row.
cmd_only_missing_desc: Shows only rows where a value is missing.
cmd_only_failed_desc: Shows only rows with a failed result.
cmd_check_sheet_desc: The list to fill in by hand at the machine. Choose it for the commands on the right.
cmd_inspection_report_desc: The report with the measured values and the verdict. Choose it for the commands on the right.
field_report_format_desc: File type of the chosen document.
field_report_language_desc: Language of the exported document, independent of the app language.
cmd_open_after_desc: Opens the file in its program when the export is done.
cmd_save_copy_desc: Exports the chosen document to a file. Not issued: numbering stays open.
cmd_issue_report_desc: Exports the chosen document as issued: numbering is locked and the report is recorded. Undo is possible.
cmd_fit_desc: Fits the whole sheet into the window.
cmd_show_table_desc: Shows or hides the characteristic table under the drawing.
cmd_show_side_panel_desc: Shows or hides the properties pane right of the drawing.
field_theme_desc: Light, dark or the same as the system.
reason_no_project: Open or start a project first.
reason_busy: DimoMark is working, wait a moment.
reason_numbering_locked: Numbering is locked by an issued report.
reason_no_part: Click a cell of a part in the grid first.
reason_no_row: Click a row in the grid first.
reason_not_drawing: Only while the drawing is shown.
reason_no_sheet: The project has no sheet on screen.
placing_hint: Click a dimension, or drag a box around it.
start_lead: Start with the customer's drawing. DimoMark numbers the dimensions, works out the limits and writes the inspection report.
start_new_text: Pick a PDF drawing. DimoMark opens it and asks for the general tolerance, unit and scale.
start_step1_text: Click each dimension or drag a box around it.
start_step2_text: Type the values into the grid, like in a spreadsheet.
start_step3_text: Check sheet and inspection report as PDF or Excel.
setup_lead: A few answers from the title block, then you can start ballooning. You can change them later on the Drawing tab.
setup_general_hint: Look for "ISO 2768" in the title block. In "ISO 2768-mK" the small letter m is the class.
setup_sheet_all: Applies to all {count} sheets. Change single sheets later on the Drawing tab.
cmd_setup_checklist_desc: Shows the setup pane again: general tolerance, unit and scale, part number and customer.
empty_measure_no_project: Start a project from a drawing or open one. Then you type the measured values here.
empty_report_no_project: Start a project from a drawing or open one. Then you print its check sheet and inspection report here.
empty_table_text: Each balloon you place on the drawing adds a row here.
empty_selection_text: Click a balloon on the drawing or a row in the table to see its details here.
empty_selection_none: There are no balloons yet. Place the first one; its details show here.
empty_measure_no_chars_text: Values belong to characteristics. Balloon the drawing first, then come back here.
empty_measure_not_inspected: No characteristic has Inspect switched on. Switch it on in the table below the drawing.
empty_measure_filtered_text: Switch the filter off to see all rows again.
empty_measure_no_parts_text: Add the parts you measure. Each part gets a column for its values.
empty_report_no_chars_text: The reports list the characteristics of the drawing. Balloon the drawing first.
empty_report_no_results_text: You can print the check sheet now and measure on paper. The inspection report needs the measured values.
review_title: Review comes in a later version
review_text: DimoMark will then find the dimensions on the drawing by itself and list them here. You go through the list and accept or correct each one. Until then you balloon by hand.
cmd_close_project_desc: Closes the project. DimoMark asks first if there are unsaved changes.
cmd_export_desc: Exports the ballooned drawing and the characteristic list. Reports are on the Report tab.
cmd_print_desc: Opens the chosen report in your PDF viewer, where you print it.
cmd_options_desc: Your personal settings: light or dark, language, your name, company name and export defaults.
cmd_about_desc: Version, license, and the licenses of all fonts, icons and libraries that come with DimoMark.
cmd_project_balloon_style_desc: Shape, size, line and color of every balloon of the project without a style of its own.
tolerance_drawing_rule_hint: A company table that applies to this drawing before the general tolerance.
project_dialog_hint: Saved with the project. Each change applies at once and can be undone.
options_lead: Your personal settings. They apply to every project on this computer and are never saved in a project.
options_export_hint: DimoMark remembers what you chose last on the Report tab. Change it here or there.
options_not_in_project: Settings of a project (tolerances, balloon style, part and report data) are on the Drawing tab and in File > Info.
about_lead: DimoMark is open source. The license texts below come with every copy of the app.
about_license: DimoMark is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. License texts are shown in their original English.
about_bundled_lead: DimoMark brings these fonts and icons with it, so it never loads anything from the internet. Each comes with its copyright notice and full license text.
about_third_party_text: DimoMark is built with the open source libraries below: the Rust crates of the program, the packages of the user interface and the PDF library PDFium. The list shows each one with its copyright notice and the full text of its license. The same list comes with every installer as the file THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.
about_diagnostics_text: For a bug report: copies the DimoMark version, the operating system, your settings and the last lines of the log file. It never contains drawing or project content. Your name, company name and home folder are replaced. File names in log lines stay, so a problem with a file can be traced. Nothing is sent; paste the text where you report the problem.
recent_empty: No recent projects yet. Projects you open or save appear here.
recent_missing_title: {path} was moved, renamed or is on a drive that is not connected.
info_lead: Everything saved with this project. It travels with the file and prints on the reports.
info_no_project: No project is open. Start one from a drawing or open a project.
info_personal_hint: Your personal settings (language, your name, light or dark) are not saved in the project. You find them under
file_open_lead: Open a project file, or one of the projects you opened or saved last.
measure_bar_none: Choose a cell in the grid.
measure_bar_value_desc: Type the value of the active cell. Enter confirms and moves to the next row, Esc cancels.
report_check_no_parts: No parts yet: the report has no results.
report_check_complete: Every part has a value for each characteristic.
report_check_draft: Rows with limits from a draft tolerance table: {count}.
report_check_changed: Rows whose limits or result type changed after the last issued report: {count}.
report_check_fields_missing: Still empty in the report header: {fields}.
report_check_fields_ok: The report header is filled in.
report_check_blank_sheet: The check sheet has empty result columns to fill in by hand.
report_issue_hint: Issuing locks the numbering and records the report. Undo is possible.
report_preview_failed: The preview could not be made: {message}
report_preview_xlsx: Save copy writes an Excel workbook with the same content. The preview shows the PDF.
report_print_done: Opened {file} in your PDF viewer. Print it from there.
reason_print_running: The report is being opened for printing.
cmd_more_exports_desc: Exports the ballooned PDF and the characteristic list (File > Export).
file_export_lead: The ballooned drawing and the characteristic list for other programs.
file_export_to_report: Check sheet and inspection report are on the Report tab.
cmd_numbering_options_desc: How repeated features (4X) are numbered and which number a characteristic gets when it is added while numbering is locked.
pane_hide: Hide the pane (View tab shows it again)
